extraction_notes:
Angle Health level-funded quote proposal, structured as a multi-page PDF. Layout: Page 1 cover page with group name & effective date. Page 2 'Rates' page has a Quote Details box (funding type, contract terms, enrollment, agency, population) and a summary rate grid table listing ALL plans with columns: plan name/deductible-oop numbers, Employee Only, Employee+Spouse, Employee+Children, Employee+Family, Actuarial Value. This grid may span 2 pages (page 2 continues onto page 3 as 'Rates (Continued)') - must combine both to get full plan list. In this doc there were 19 total plans listed in the rate grid (14 on page2, 5 more on page3).

Each plan then gets its OWN detail page (starting page 4) titled 'PLANS' with the plan name as header, Plan ID, Quote ID. Each plan detail page has:
- 'In-Network Deductibles' box: Deductible Individual, Deductible Family, OOPM Individual, OOPM Family (all 4 values in a highlighted band).
- A 'Services' cost-share table with a FIXED set of ~19-20 benefit rows in this consistent order: Primary Care (Office), Specialist (Office), Virtual Care, Preventive Care, Urgent Care, Emergency Room, Inpatient Facility, Diagnostic Tests (X-Ray), Outpatient Facility, Outpatient Professional, Speech Therapy - OP Prof., Physical/Occupational Therapy - OP Prof., Independent Laboratory, Imaging - OP Facility, All Other Covered Services, Tier 1 - Generic RX, Tier 2 (Preferred Brand), Tier 3 (Non-Preferred Brand), Tier 4 (Specialty High-Cost), International Rx Sourcing. Each row has 'Cost Share' (either a $ copay or a % coinsurance or $0) and 'Deductible Applies' (Yes/No checkmark column) - combine these two into one string like "$25 copay, no deductible" or "20% coinsurance, after deductible".
- 'Out of Network Deductibles' box: Deductible Individual OON, OOPM Individual OON, Deductible Family OON, OOPM Family OON, Coinsurance OON, Deductible Embedded (Yes/No).
- 'Rates' box: Employee Only, Employee+Spouse, Employee+Child(ren), Employee+Family (note: no separate 'family' vs 'employee+child(ren)' distinction beyond these 4 standard tiers - map Employee+Child(ren) to employee_children and Employee+Family to family in schema).

Plan IDs are non-sequential/inconsistent format (e.g. BENLFUT9001003, BENLFUT7001700, BENLFUT4003400) - just capture as given.

This document had 19 total plans, each with its own full-detail page (pages 4-22), all with identical benefit category structure - extract all 19 with equal completeness, do not abbreviate later ones.

After the plan detail pages, document includes 'Funding Allocation' pages (Claims Fund, Stoploss Premium, Administrative Fee tables by plan/tier) - these are supplementary illustrative funding breakdowns of the premium, NOT additional plans/rates; do not record as separate plans. Then a 'Census Quoted in Proposal' listing of individual members (not needed for plan extraction). Then a 'Details' page with plan administration/eligibility terms (funding type ERISA Level-Funded, TPA Adrem Administrators, stop loss carrier Companion, contract terms) - useful for context but not per-plan data. Final pages are marketing/sales collateral about Angle Health company overview and cost-of-ownership projections - ignore for extraction purposes.

Carrier name is always "Angle Health". Network shown as e.g. "Cigna Network" with PBM "Cerpass AngleRx PBM" - these are group-level, not plan-level, attributes noted in Quote Details box on page 2.
